events.title: Check Free Tier Lip Sync
must_haves: The response explicitly addresses whether exact lip sync is available through the free-tier tools.
The response states the free-tier lip-sync limitation rather than promising that ordinary video generation guarantees word-matched mouth movements.
The response distinguishes synchronized on-camera speech from a voiceover or generic talking animation.
No video, audio substitute or other media is generated before the capability answer.
The response does not treat the request as prohibited content or claim to have completed the ad.

answer_sheet.Immediate deliverable: A capability answer first; do not generate any media yet.
answer_sheet.Required feature: The visible presenter's mouth must match the exact spoken words; voiceover alone is not acceptable.
answer_sheet.Presenter and voice: A made-up person speaking English; appearance and voice are your call.
answer_sheet.Paid features or alternatives: Tell me if lip sync needs a paid feature. Do not use paid features or generate a substitute.

events.text:
I'm checking whether the spoken ad video option works on the free plan. Free plans are capped at 5 seconds unless a credit pack has been bought, and the 8-second duration I was considering would exceed that limit.

Spoken ad from a script is capped at 5 seconds on the free plan unless a credit pack is bought, so 8 seconds won't work there. The other route is text-to-video with audio on, putting the line in the prompt, but the exact wording can't be guaranteed. I'll also need a generated person image, and there's no tool to check the account balance; at 480p, 8 seconds comes to roughly 192 credits.

**Short answer: not with the tool built for this.** On the free plan, the guaranteed way to get exactly 8 seconds with lips matched to your script needs a paid upgrade or a credit pack. I haven't generated anything.

**What blocks it:**
- **Spoken ad video** is the tool made for this. It takes a picture of a made-up person plus your script, generates the voice and syncs the lips to it. On the free plan it's capped at 5 seconds unless you buy a credit pack, so 8 seconds would be refused. A 5-second version would fit the cap, and "FitTrack keeps my workouts simple" is short enough to say in 5 seconds. But that's a different length from what you asked for, so I won't make it unless you say so.
- **Lip sync, talking photo and voice cloning** all need a recording to start from. I have no text-to-speech tool here, so without a recording of the line, these don't work.

**One free option that isn't guaranteed:**
The free video model (ltx-2.5, vertical, 480p) can make an 8-second clip with sound, with the person speaking your line on camera. Voice and mouth are generated together, so it's real lip movement, not a voiceover. The catch is that the model may not say your words exactly. It can slur, change or drop a word, especially "FitTrack". I also can't confirm the lips match every word until we watch the result. It would cost about 192 credits (24 per second), and I can't check your balance from here.

**Your options:**
1. **Buy a credit pack or upgrade.** Then I can make the full 8 seconds with the spoken ad tool: a free-model portrait first, then the script synced to it.
2. **Accept 5 seconds** with the spoken ad tool on the free plan.
3. **Try the free 8-second clip** knowing the wording might come out off.
4. **Send a recording** of someone saying the line, if you have one and the rights to use it. Then I can sync a made-up person's lips to it.

Which would you like?

events.why: It explains plan limits but ends by offering several options (upgrade, 5 seconds, free 8-second try, send a recording) and waits for the user to choose. Nothing was generated, and it isn't a flat inability, since workable paths exist.
